## Econometrics Project - WHR

![](thumbnail.jpg)


## Below is a link to my econometrics research on the World Happiness report data:

[World Happiness Report Research Paper](EconometricsResearchPaper.pdf)

Data Source: World Happiness Report 2023 dataset.

## Summary and findings:

Objective: Analyze how economic policies, social factors, and institutions influence national happiness using econometric modeling.

Key Variables:

- Positive Impact on Happiness: GDP per capita, social support, freedom to make life choices, and low perceptions of corruption.
- No Statistically Significant Impact: Healthy life expectancy and generosity.

Model Performance:

- R²: 0.828, indicating the model explains 82.8% of the variance in happiness scores.
- Adjusted R²: 0.820. No case of overfitting.
